description: This file contains CSS rules and variables for theming and styling the frontend of a tic-tac-toe application. It defines styles for light and dark themes, as well as specific styles for elements like the app header, links, and a theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class that centers the content and sets the background and text color based on theme variables.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Logo class that defines the size and animation for the application logo.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header class for the application that defines layout and styling of the header section.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for links in the application; defines the text color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the theme toggle button, which allows users to switch between light and dark themes.
